run_gil_scoped_tests: run the pybind11 GIL scoped test suite to verify GIL acquire and release behavior
test_cross_module_gil: test that the GIL can be acquired and released across pybind11 modules without segfaults
test_gil_deadlock_detection: test for GIL deadlocks by running pybind11 callbacks in separate processes with timeout detection
test_gil_nested_acquire: test nested GIL acquire patterns using pybind11 test_release_acquire and test_nested_acquire functions
review_extendedvirtclass: review the ExtendedVirtClass that extends pybind11 VirtClass with virtual_func and pure_virtual_func implementations
